cat > /root/contrastive_entrain_calib/training/launch_exp004.sh << 'SHELLEOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

SNAP_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/models--Qwen--Qwen3-8B/snapshots"
SNAP=$(ls "$SNAP_DIR" | head -1)
MODEL_PATH="$SNAP_DIR/$SNAP"

echo "[launch] Waiting for model download to complete..."
while true; do
    n_incomplete=$(ls /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/models--Qwen--Qwen3-8B/blobs/*.incomplete 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    if [ "$n_incomplete" -eq 0 ]; then
        break
    fi
    echo "[launch] $n_incomplete shards still downloading... waiting 60s"
    sleep 60
done
echo "[launch] Model download complete. Verifying..."

n_shards=$(find "$MODEL_PATH" -name "model-*.safetensors" | wc -l)
echo "[launch] Found $n_shards model shards in $MODEL_PATH"
if [ "$n_shards" -lt 5 ]; then
    echo "[launch] ERROR: Expected 5 shards, found $n_shards"
    exit 1
fi

echo "[launch] Starting dry-run (2 steps)..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 /root/contrastive_entrain_calib/training/run_exp004_act_baseline.py --max-steps 2 2>&1 | tail -20
echo "[launch] Dry-run passed. Starting full training..."

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 /root/contrastive_entrain_calib/training/run_exp004_act_baseline.py
SHELLEOF
chmod +x /root/contrastive_entrain_calib/training/launch_exp004.sh
echo "Done"
